summary:
Russia, Ukraine and the United States ended two days of talks in Abu Dhabi, the first such meeting since February. Ukraine's delegation was led by Rustem Umerov. The sides agreed a prisoner swap, but Moscow remains cool on European involvement, and a Russian negotiator said more talks will be held.

Spain's first general strike in 14 years disrupted public transport and closed many businesses on Wednesday, with workers across nearly all industries demanding action on housing and the rising cost of living. The strike comes less than three weeks before national elections on November 29, which could bring the far right to power.

The US House of Representatives on Tuesday rejected a resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over his conduct in office and his handling of the war in Iran, though Democrats can try again next year. Trump praised Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot." The New York Times reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has moved from his Washington home to a military base after Iranian threats against his life, two people familiar with the matter said.

headlines.title: Russia, Ukraine and US end Abu Dhabi talks
headlines.summary: Delegations from Russia, Ukraine and the United States concluded two days of talks in Abu Dhabi, the first such meeting since February. The sides agreed a prisoner swap, but Moscow remains cool on European involvement, and a Russian negotiator said more talks will be held.

headlines.title: Spain holds first general strike in 14 years
headlines.summary: Workers across nearly all industries joined the walkout over housing and rising living costs, disrupting public transport. The strike comes less than three weeks before national elections on November 29.

headlines.title: House rejects bid to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth
headlines.summary: The House turned aside a resolution on Tuesday to impeach Pete Hegseth over his conduct in office and his handling of the war in Iran. Democrats can try again next year, and Trump praised Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot".

headlines.title: Bessent moves to military base over Iranian threats
headlines.summary: The New York Times reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has left his Washington home for a US military base after Iranian threats against his life, two people familiar with the matter said. Iran is said to have geolocated his $12.5m Washington mansion after a photo of it was published.

headlines.title: UK arrests US soldier suspected of spying for Russia
headlines.summary: London police arrested a 41-year-old member of the US Army in Britain on Tuesday on suspicion of spying for Russia. He was in custody pending possible charges after an investigation with the FBI and US military intelligence.

headlines.title: US charges three alleged Iranian operatives over UK airbase plot
headlines.summary: The US Justice Department on Tuesday charged three men it described as Iranian operatives over an alleged terrorist plot at RAF Fairford in Britain. Prosecutors say the men planned a "campaign of terror" against Jewish communities and a UK airbase.

headlines.title: France blames Iran for cyberattack on supermarket fridges
headlines.summary: France blamed Iran for a cyberattack on hundreds of supermarket refrigeration units and summoned the Iranian ambassador. Iran categorically rejected what it called baseless and one-sided accusations, and the EU said it would seek a swift and united response.

headlines.title: Over 300 Italian schools evacuated after bomb alert emails
headlines.summary: At least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated on Wednesday after receiving the same bomb alert message, the education minister said. The alert came amid rising European concerns about hybrid warfare threats.
